_comment: The 17 natural-language queries given in the Comparables.ai technical
assessment brief, verbatim. Shared by tests/test_parser.py and
scripts/benchmark.py so the parser contract and the published performance
numbers are measured against exactly the same inputs.
`expect` records what the parser should extract. It is the assertion target
in the test suite, not a hint used at runtime.
